2608.11919.title: LazyTrain: Limited-resource Allocation toward Zero-waste Yield Optimization in Large Language Model Training
2608.11919.paper_summary: Training large language models on limited hardware is increasingly a scheduling problem across GPU compute, host memory, PCIe transfer, and storage bandwidth. Existing offloading systems reduce GPU residency, and MegaTrain shows that a CPU-master layer-streaming executor can train large models on a single GPU, but fixed checkpointing and placement heuristics still leave communication exposed on the critical path. We propose LazyTrain, an optimization layer over a layer-streaming executor. LazyTrain formulates checkpoint selection, activation placement, recomputation, and CPU-GPU-NVMe communication overlap as a mixed-integer scheduling problem, then executes the solved policy during training. It further couples 8-bit optimizer states with fast gradient clipping as a single Hybrid 8-bit operator: state compression reduces optimizer-state memory, while fast clipping counteracts the additional CPU-side update overhead. Across H800 experiments from Qwen2.5-3B to Qwen3.6-27B, LazyTrain improves sustained TFLOPS over matched baselines runs by approximately 1.24$\times$; RTX 3090 experiments likewise increase the maximum feasible batch size by one at each model scale. In the primary Qwen3.6-27B H800 MetaMathQA run, LazyTrain reaches 219.95 TFLOPS and 1361 tokens/s at batch size 72, peaks at 68.84\,GB of GPU memory, and obtains 95.42\% exact-match accuracy on the full evaluation split. The source code is available at https://github.com/DataArcTech/LazyTrain.
2608.11919.paper_summary_zh: 訓練大型語言模型在有限硬體上的問題越來越成為一個調度問題，涉及到GPU計算、主記憶體、PCIe傳輸和儲存帶寬。現有的卸載系統減少了GPU的佔用，而MegaTrain顯示一個CPU主控層的流式執行器可以在單個GPU上訓練大型模型，但固定的檢查點和放置啟發式仍然使得通信在關鍵路徑上暴露。我們提出LazyTrain，一個在流式執行器上的優化層。LazyTrain將檢查點選擇、激活放置、重新計算和CPU-GPU-NVMe通信重疊公式化為一個混合整數調度問題，然後在訓練期間執行解決的策略。它進一步將8位優化器狀態與快速梯度裁剪結合為一個單一的混合8位運算元：狀態壓縮減少優化器狀態的記憶體，而快速裁剪則抵消了額外的CPU端更新開銷。在從Qwen2.5-3B到Qwen3.6-27B的H800實驗中，LazyTrain在匹配基準運行中將持續TFLOPS提高了約1.24$\times$；RTX 3090實驗同樣在每個模型規模上將最大可行批次大小增加了一個。在主要的Qwen3.6-27B H800 MetaMathQA運行中，LazyTrain達到了219.95 TFLOPS和1361 tokens/s，批次大小為72，GPU記憶體峰值達到68.84\,GB，並在完整評估分割上獲得了95.42\%的精確匹配準確率。源代碼可在 https://github.com/DataArcTech/LazyTrain 獲得。
